name: Container Homes Routes
description: Development fork of Container Homes: set a home URL and up to 9 app slots per Firefox container. Project and account routing is in progress.

open-container-homes.description: Open the home URL for the current container

group-tabs-by-container.description: Group and sort this window's tabs by container

focus-previous-group.description: Switch to the first tab of the previous tab group

focus-next-group.description: Switch to the first tab of the next tab group

open-tab-in-group.description: Open a new tab in the current tab's group and container

open-slot-1.description: Switch to or open slot 1 for the current container
